description: Columns of stacked colored rectangles on a 15x15 grid scrolling vertically with wraparound; the palette inverts on click and mid-loop
notable: Palette can flip to a computed photographic negative via the rybitten invert util, toggled on click and at frame 120.

description: Interlocking plus/cross motifs tiled across an 11x13 grid; hues rotate continuously through the loop
notable: Animation is pure hue rotation (+360*playhead) over the rybitten-generated palette; several alternate lerp schemes left commented.

description: A stretched rectangular window/frame motif tiled across a 13x15 grid over a light ground
A single Clixo-toy form (rounded clover with corner rings) opening and closing as its corners rotate
notable: Form is modeled on the Clixo magnetic toy; the open/close is done by rotating corner arcs and re-stitching sides with kappa-matched bezier curves.

description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in black and white placed by An+B modulo rules, with outlined negative-space forms interleaved
Grid of Clixo clover forms in outline and fill layers arranged by modulo patterns, inset by a margin
Dense 21x21 grid of Clixo clover forms whose base color is chosen by sampling a low-frequency 2D noise field
Grid of Clixo clover forms two-toned by column parity
A single large Clixo clover form (rounded square with four corner rings) centered on the canvas
notable: The base form itself, built from eight stitched circle arcs plus corner rings and inner dots.

description: Grid of Clixo clover forms in three color layers placed by staggered An+B modulo rules
Grid of Clixo clover forms in four color layers keyed to row/column modulo combinations
Dense 21x21 grid of Clixo forms whose placement per layer is driven by random An+B modulo periods
notable: Each of four layers picks random modulo divisor and offset, so the composition is chance-driven.

description: Clixo clover forms stacked into vertical columns (every 4th column), two-toned by row parity with accent forms
Clixo clover forms in vertical columns opening and closing as their corners rotate over the loop
A single cluster grows outward from a seed by probabilistic neighbor accretion, rendered as shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid
notable: Growth is revealed cell-by-cell with a per-glyph shuffle transition; neighbor color is chosen by weighted vote so clusters stay coherent.

description: Multiple accretion clusters seeded at packed-circle centers, each growing to its circle radius, drawn as shaded ascii blocks
notable: pack-spheres sets seed positions and per-cluster growth caps, so clusters fill roughly circular territories.

description: Six accretion clusters grow from random seeds via probabilistic neighbor spread, rendered as shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid
Six accretion clusters grow from random seeds to radius limits, resetting each loop; shaded ascii blocks over a dotted grid
Six accretion clusters grown fully in a precompute pass, then rendered as a fixed field of shaded ascii blocks
notable: Growth runs to a stable state in an up-front while-loop, so every frame draws the same finished image (no reveal).

description: Test harness driving the shared cluster-growth accretion engine, rendering one grown field of shaded ascii blocks
notable: Only sketch in the folder that calls the extracted ./system createClusterSystem engine rather than inlining the growth logic.

description: 24 convex polygons drift inward and bounce, with SAT collision resolution and wall reflections
notable: Spawn overlaps are resolved up front by nudging along the minimum translation vector before the animation starts.

description: 24 convex polygons bounce and collide via SAT physics, drawn as white outlines on black
Colliding polygons shatter into fragments built by k-means clustering and convex hulls of interior points
notable: On impact each polygon fractures: interior points are k-means clustered and hulled into convex shards that fly off with rotated velocity.

description: Debug view of SAT spawn placement: 12 polygons resolve initial overlaps (flagged red) then bounce, using a self-contained SAT implementation
notable: Standalone copy of the SAT engine (not the shared SAT.ts); overlapping spawns are highlighted red to debug placement.
